intro.text: A seven-year-old parshwoman, the daughter of Sah, travelling with a group of newly awakened parshmen.

items.text: Vai and her father had been slaves in northern Alethkar; her mother had been sold away. After the Everstorm, they travelled with Khen's group following a spren. When the group captured Kaladin, Vai held her father's hand on the march and, while Sah played cards, ran off to pick flowering rockbuds, giggling as she caught them.

Watching Vai helped Kaladin see the parshmen were not monsters, but when he still called them runaway slaves, Sah grabbed him and asked if he knew what it was to watch his family torn apart. In the scramble afterwards, Kaladin stepped on Vai's flower.

Afterwards Vai brought Kaladin a waterskin and asked whether the humans would chase them and why they could not be left alone. She promised she never hit anyone when angry. Kaladin explained that the humans saw them as a resource, and could not find a way to explain slavery to a seven-year-old.
As the group neared Revolar, Sah carried Vai on his shoulders, and she clutched some wooden cards like a favourite toy. Sah told Kaladin he would never let anyone take Vai and imprison her again.
When Sah, Khen and their group were sent to fight at Kholinar, supposedly as punishment for sheltering Kaladin, the Fused had Vai taken from her father. Sah was furious but could do nothing.

appearance.text: Like the other young girls in the group she wears her hair loose, and her carapace is the light orange-pink of a child rather than her elders' armour.
She goes barefoot, and her callused feet are covered with scratches.

personality.text: Seems timid around Kaladin at first, but he soon realises she is only nervous.
